Name: OpenFire English Re-Translated
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
Again, what it says on the tin.

OpenFire has been one of my favorite NPC mods for quite some time now, and I'm eternally grateful to PeachyYogurt for updating him to 1.6, deprivedgayotic for their original translation of him for 1.5, and for FireCherno to creating and uploading him in the first place. The uploader for the original OpenFire 1.6 english translation deleted their account, and I wasn't really a big fan of it to begin with, so I took up the mantle to create one that's up to my own standards.

A fair warning; I don't really know chinese. Most of the core translating was done using DeepL, but I've gone through all of the dialogue with a fine-tooth comb to smooth over grammatical errors and localize it to the best of my ability. That being said, since I don't know chinese, there may be things that have been lost to translation, or interpreted poorly as a result. If someone familiar with both languages notices an error in my translation, they're free to edit it themselves and upload it, or roast me alive in the comments T~T.
[size=2]
[/size][size=3]That being said, off to the technical stuff![/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]CONTENT WARNING:
[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]As much as I love this mod, I must say that this definitely isn't suited for all audiences. OpenFire deals with touchy subjects such as:

- Sexually suggestive dialogue
- A brief mention of sexual assault
- Foul language/cursing
- Religious figures and entities (this one's obvious since he's a demon, but I digress)
- Stalking and obsessive/possessive behavior
- Mentions of blood/gore.

...I think that covers all of the bases I can think of off of the top of my head. If any of the above bothers you in fictional media, then do not install the original mod and this translation.
[/size]
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]COOL, THIS IS RIGHT UP MY ALLEY! HOW DO I INSTALL IT NOW?
[/b][/size][/color]
I'm glad you asked!
You'll need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27651]PeachyYogurt's 1.6 conversion of OpenFire[/url] first. Once that's installed, just unzip the folder into the i18n folder! I've included an unedited copy of the original dialogue as well to prevent losing the original file in case you need it for whatever reason.
[size=4][b]
[color=#ff7700]Additional notes I wanna add:

[/color][/b][/size][size=3]I have tested the translation myself to ensure it works, and have done my best to keep typos and errors to a minimum. However, it's still very possible that I missed something. If you find a major error in this translation, don't hesitate to tell me and I'll do my best to fix it!

I want to thank the above parties again for immensely enhancing my experience of Stardew Valley with their contributions, and I can only hope that this will continue to pay it forward.

Also I highly recommend installing and using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8282]Shiinoro's Shie styled portraits![/url]﻿ They're wonderfully done and helped to inspire me throughout the process.

I think that's about it! Thank you for visiting my mod and I hope you have a nice day/night![/size]
